description: This PHP class, `RequestParams`, encapsulates handling of different types of request parameters (body, attributes, query) within an API request context. It provides methods to retrieve and validate various parameter types, including strings, integers, floats, booleans, arrays, date/time objects, and base64-encoded attachments. It also includes specific handling for sanitizing SVG images embedded within attachments. The class relies on external classes for validation, sanitization, and data transfer objects (DTOs).

classes.name: RequestParams
classes.description: Handles extraction and validation of request parameters for API endpoints, supporting various data types and binary attachments with SVG sanitization.

methods.name: getString
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter from the specified parameter bag, with a default fallback.

methods.name: getStringOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter that may be null, with optional conversion of empty strings to null.

methods.name: getInt
methods.description: Retrieves an integer parameter, throws an exception if an empty string is encountered.

methods.name: getIntOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves an integer parameter or null if not present.

methods.name: getFloatOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves a float parameter or null.

methods.name: getBooleanOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean parameter or null.

methods.name: getArrayOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves an array parameter or null.

methods.name: getAttachmentOrNull
methods.description: Gets a Base64 attachment object or null, with SVG sanitization if applicable.

methods.name: getDateTime
methods.description: Retrieves a DateTime object from the request parameters, setting the timezone if provided.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a parameter exists in the specified parameter bag.
